backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor serving as a placeholder backend entry point with no implemented functionality.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting three completed features related to replacing WorkflowSection with ReferralProgramSection component displaying Spanish referral program information with commission structure details.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of all frontend files describing the BlueFire cybersecurity website components, sections, and configuration in Spanish for Mexican market targeting PYMEs and maquiladoras.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with OKLCH color system defining cybersecurity-themed design tokens for light and dark modes including primary blues, accent cyans, and chart colors.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with Spanish language attribute, SEO meta tags for BlueFire cybersecurity targeting Mexican PYMEs and maquiladoras, and root div for React mounting.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React application component composing the complete single-page website with Hero, Services, Market Context, Target Clients, Referral Program, Pilot Program, Contact, and Footer sections.
frontend/src/components/ContactSection.t: Contact section component with Angel Medina's contact information cards (email, phone, location) and a Spanish-labeled contact form with frontend-only validation and success message display.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component displaying BlueFire branding, services list, contact information, copyright with dynamic year, and caffeine.ai attribution link with UTM tracking parameters.
frontend/src/components/HeroSection.tsx: Hero section with BlueFire branding on white background, Spanish tagline about cybersecurity protection for Mexico, dual CTAs for evaluation and services, and three key statistics about Mexican cyber threats.
frontend/src/components/MarketContextSec: Displays cybersecurity threat statistics for Mexico with four stat cards, a horizontal bar chart showing the most affected sectors (Finance, Health, Manufacturing), and an alert box highlighting PYME vulnerability gaps.
frontend/src/components/PilotProgramSect: Presents a pilot program offering a 48-hour vulnerability scan with a four-step process (contact, documents, execution, delivery), deliverables list, optional add-on services (remediation and monthly retainer), and a call-to-action button.
frontend/src/components/ReferralProgramS: Outlines a referral program with four benefit cards (15-30% commission, 15% of first contract value, guaranteed payment, 30-day transfer) and a three-step process explanation for how the referral program works.
frontend/src/components/SectorChart.tsx: Renders an SVG pie chart from sector data with percentage-based segments, calculates an "Otros" category to reach 100%, and displays a color-coded legend below the chart.
Displays four cybersecurity services (Asset Registry, Vulnerability Assessment, Remediation, Network Segmentation) in a grid layout with icons, descriptions, necessity explanations for the Mexican market, and bulleted benefits for each service.
frontend/src/components/TargetClientsSec: Presents two client segment comparison cards (PYMEs vs. Maquiladoras) with their characteristics, followed by a grid of four target client types (local SMBs, manufacturing plants, supply chain providers, MSPs/IT providers) with icons and descriptions.
React component displaying a four-step cybersecurity workflow (Asset Registry, Vulnerability Assessment, Patching, Segmentation) with icons, stages, and an integrated workflow diagram image.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom React hook that creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous actor instance for backend communication, invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication, providing login/logout functionality, identity state management, and authentication status tracking.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with cybersecurity-themed color palette (deep blue, cyan, slate gray) for both light and dark modes using OKLCH color space.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query client and Internet Identity provider, then renders the root App component.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending default theme with custom colors (using OKLCH), typography, container queries, animations, and cybersecurity-themed design tokens.
project_state.json: Project metadata defining a Spanish-language cybersecurity presentation website for BlueFire targeting Mexican PYMEs and manufacturing plants, with features for hero section, services, market context, and target clients.
